title: PRSA Code of Ethics
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Core values (advocacy, honesty, expertise, independence, loyalty, fairness); gifts to journalists modest and rare; reveal sponsors of causes; correct errors; front groups improper; first developed in 1950

title: CIPR Code of Conduct
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Never conceal the role of representing a client; check information for accuracy before sharing; declare conflicts; protect confidences; code appendix dated November 2025

title: CERC: Introduction (2018 update)
publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF read locally). Six principles: be first, be right, be credible, express empathy, promote action, show respect; phases preparation, initial, maintenance, resolution; what to say in the initial phase

title: CERC Manual
publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Manual chapters on crisis communication plans, spokespersons and working with the media; page dated 20 November 2024, chapters last updated 2014 to 2019

title: The PESO Model breakdown
supports: Opened with WebFetch. PESO (paid, earned, shared, owned) created by Gini Dietrich, launched in 2014 with the book Spin Sucks; what each media type covers

title: Barcelona Principles 4.0
publisher: AMEC (International Association for the Measurement and Evaluation of Communication)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Fourth version of principles that have existed since 2010; measurement should be meaningful, transparent and outcome-driven. The page text does not list the principles, so none are quoted

title: Say No to AVEs
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Industry campaign (from June 2017) to stop using advertising value equivalents; supporters call AVEs outdated and flawed; recommends Barcelona Principles and the Integrated Evaluation Framework

title: Digital News Report 2026: executive summary
publisher: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Published 16 June 2026; 97,520 respondents in 48 markets; trust in news 37%; social and video networks 54% vs news sites and apps 51%; AI chatbots for news 10% weekly (7% the year before); news creators 27%; news podcasts 11%; US trust 25%

title: EurekAlert! help: embargoes and reporter access
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Definition of a news embargo; only legitimate content owners set embargoes; reporters apply for access and sign an embargo agreement

title: EurekAlert! embargo agreement
supports: Opened with WebFetch. What reporters agree to: hold news until release time, share with no one, do not upload embargoed material to AI tools; a breach may suspend the reporter and their whole outlet

title: Selective Disclosure and Insider Trading (Regulation FD), Release 33-7881
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Effective 23 October 2000; disclose material nonpublic information to the public simultaneously (intentional) or promptly (24 hours or next NYSE open); covered recipients are market professionals and likely-trading holders, not the news media; a wire press release or Form 8-K counts as public disclosure; website posting alone generally not enough

title: UK Market Abuse Regulation
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Issuers disclose inside information as soon as possible; delay only if three conditions are met, then tell the FCA; EU MAR from 3 July 2016, onshored 31 December 2020; page updated 23 February 2026

title: Spam policies for Google web search: link spam
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Links with optimized anchor text in press releases distributed on other sites count as link spam; paid links are fine when marked nofollow or sponsored

title: Qualify your outbound links to Google
supports: Opened with WebFetch. rel="sponsored" for paid or sponsored links (nofollow still acceptable), rel="ugc" and rel="nofollow"

title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Guides revised 2023; free products and payment are material connections that need clear and conspicuous disclosure; reviewers who get free products generally disclose

title: Influencers' guide to making clear that ads are ads
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Fourth edition dated 23 October 2026, made with the CMA; covers when creator content is an ad, how to label it, fake reviews and the DMCC Act

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Rule in effect from 21 October 2024; bans fake reviews and testimonials, undisclosed insider reviews, review suppression and fake social media indicators

title: Data Breach Response: A Guide for Business
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Guide dated August 2023: all states, DC, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands have breach notification laws; name one point person for releasing information; do not make misleading statements; publish plain-language answers; what a notice should say

title: Data protection guide for small business: data breaches
supports: Opened with WebFetch. GDPR: notify the data protection authority within 72 hours unless the breach is unlikely to pose a risk; tell individuals without undue delay when risk is high; document every breach

title: Recall Guidance
supports: Opened with WebFetch. CPSC compiles recall handbooks and the business duty to report; separate guides for recall websites, social media, posters and video news releases

title: Product recalls and alerts
publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards (GOV.UK)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. UK businesses may need to notify their market surveillance authority of unsafe products; PAS 7100:2022 recall code of practice; page updated 6 October 2026

title: Falcon Content Update Preliminary Post Incident Report
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Faulty update 19 July 2024 at 04:09 UTC, reverted 05:27 UTC; preliminary review published 24 July 2024; promised staggered rollouts, customer control, independent reviews and a public root cause analysis

title: Helping our customers through the CrowdStrike outage
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Published 20 July 2024; about 8.5 million Windows devices affected, less than one percent of all Windows machines

title: Cloudflare outage on November 18, 2025
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Posted the same day; errors from about 11:20 UTC, core traffic restored by 14:30, all systems normal by 17:06; not an attack (first suspected as one); apology; listed follow-up fixes

title: The State of Journalism 2026
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Annual survey of nearly 1,100 journalists covering what makes a pitch land; full figures sit behind a download form, so none are used in this kit

title: Personal data breaches: a guide
supports: ico.org.uk returns 403 to automated fetches, so this exact page was confirmed from search results on 7 Nov 2026 (Decision 8). The Information Commission replaced the ICO on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name. Report a notifiable personal data breach to the regulator within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, where feasible, giving details in phases if needed; tell people without undue delay when the risk to them is high; record every breach. The page says it is under review after the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025.
